post.description: ApproveAction runs a pending action with its stored arguments. When the run succeeds, the action is done. When the run fails, the action stays pending with the error, and the Owner can approve it again. The agent gets the result in a chat message. It returns 404 for an unknown action, and 409 for an action that is not pending.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the action
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetActionBrief reads the Workstream issue of an edit_brief action from GitHub. It returns 404 for an unknown action, and 409 for an action of another tool.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the action
parameters.name: id

post.description: RejectAction rejects a pending action. No action runs, and the agent gets the message of the Owner in a chat message. It returns 404 for an unknown action, and 409 for an action that is not pending.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the action
parameters.name: id

get.description: ListActiveAgents returns the open sessions of all organizations in one group for each Role, with the slot counts and the limits of the config.

post.description: StartCheck starts the local check of a session that waits for a low load at once. The check ignores the load for this run. It returns 409 when the session does not wait for a low load.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the session
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetTranscript returns a page of the Transcript of a session, the oldest row first.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the session
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Before is the id of a row. The page has at most 100 lines with an id below Before. With no Before, the page has the newest 100 lines
parameters.name: before

get.description: StreamTranscript sends each new or changed row of the Transcript of a session. It sends no row that exists when the stream opens. When the client does not read the rows fast enough, the stream ends.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the session
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetChat returns a page of the messages of the Lead chat of a Workstream, or of the Coordinator chat of an organization.

parameters.description: Organization is the owner of the repository, or the organization of the Coordinator chat
parameters.name: organization

parameters.description: Repository is the repository of the Workstream as "owner/name". It is empty for the Coordinator chat
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Workstream is the number of the Workstream issue. It is 0 for the Coordinator chat
parameters.name: workstream

parameters.description: Before is the id of a message. The page has at most 20 messages with an id below Before. With no Before, the page has the newest 20 messages
parameters.name: before

post.description: SendChat adds a message of the Owner with its images to the chat, and gives it to the Lead or to the Coordinator. Mobius starts the agent when none runs. A message with the id of a stored message changes nothing and returns the same status. It returns 400 when the request is larger than 4 images of 5 MB with the text. It returns 409 when the organization has no repository of Mobius, or while Mobius restarts for an upgrade.

get.description: GetChatImage returns an image of a message. It returns 404 when the message has no such image.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the message
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Position is the position of the image in the message, from 0
parameters.name: position

post.description: SeeChat records that the Owner saw the messages of the chat up to a message. An earlier message than the last seen message changes nothing.
StopChat stops the turn of the agent that answers a message of the Owner. A turn for a Lead event goes on. When the agent waits for its slot, its first message of the Owner gets no turn.

get.description: GetCheckup returns the status of the App permissions and of each Mobius label in each repository of the organization.

parameters.description: Organization is the owner of the repositories
parameters.name: organization

post.description: FixLabels creates the missing Mobius labels and sets the fixed color of each Mobius label with a different color, in each repository of the organization. The description of an existing label stays.

get.description: GetCheckupTools returns the path and the version of each program that Mobius runs for its agents and its work.
ListCIStops returns one item for each open hard CI break that has a task issue, in the order of the repositories and then of the break ids.
ListDevices returns the device logins.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the device login
parameters.name: id

get.description: GetDrain returns the state of the drain.

post.description: StartDrain holds each new Worker in the queue, and returns when no agent runs or when the Owner cancels the drain.

delete.description: CancelDrain ends the drain, so the held Workers start. It does nothing while the upgrade replaces the program.

get.description: StreamEvents sends the latest activities, and then each new activity, each change of a session, each change of the drain, each start and failure of an upgrade, each change of the Workstream list, each new or longer chat message, each new unread count, each change of the state of a chat, each new or dismissed Inbox item, each new or changed pending action, each change of the pauses, each change of the CI stops, and each Workstream that the Coordinator chat created. It also sends a ping at a fixed interval. When the request has Last-Event-ID, it sends the activities after that id in place of the latest activities. When the client does not read the session changes fast enough, the stream ends.

parameters.description: LastEventID is the id of the last activity that the client got
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

get.description: ListGitHubApps returns the Mobius Apps with the repositories of their installations.

post.description: CreateManifestForm returns the form that creates a Mobius App in a GitHub account. After the form, GitHub sends the browser to GET /api/github/manifest-callback.

get.description: ManifestCallback is the page where GitHub sends the browser after it creates the App of a manifest form.

parameters.description: Code is the code that converts the manifest into an App
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: State is the state of the manifest form
parameters.name: state

Location.description: Location is the page that the browser opens next

get.description: UserCallback is the page where GitHub sends the browser after the Owner authorizes a Mobius App. GitHub sends no state after an installation, so the check of the user login protects this page.

parameters.description: Code is the code that GitHub exchanges for a user token
parameters.name: code

Location.description: Location is the page that the browser opens next

get.description: GetHealth returns the state of the server.
ListInbox returns the Inbox items that the Owner did not dismiss, the oldest first.

post.description: AnswerInboxItem posts the text as a comment of the Owner on the issue of an Inbox item. Mobius treats the comment as a comment of a trusted user. Mobius posts it with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. For a question of the Coordinator, it instead adds the text to the Coordinator chat as a message of the Owner, and the URL is empty. It returns 404 for an unknown item, 400 for an item with no issue and for an empty text, and 409 with the steps when the Owner did not authorize the App.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: Dismiss removes an item from the Inbox.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: DoneInboxItem marks the todo of an open todo Inbox item as done, with the note, and removes the item from the Inbox. When the todo was the last mandatory todo of a task with the automatic merge of Autopilot, Mobius approves the pull request for the merge. It returns the changed item. It returns 404 for an unknown item and 409 for an item that is not an open todo.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: MergeInboxItem approves the pull request of a ready for review Inbox item with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. Mobius then merges the pull request with the checks of an approval on GitHub. It returns the item in the merging state. It returns 404 for an unknown item, and 409 with the reason for an item that is not open, for a task that is not ready for review, for a pull request that is not open, and when the Owner did not authorize the App.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: SendAgain adds the Owner message of an open Lead failed item to its chat again, with the same text and images, and removes the item from the Inbox. It returns 409 for an item that is not an open Lead failed item with a message, and while Mobius restarts for an upgrade.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the Inbox item
parameters.name: id

post.description: Login makes a device login when the password is the access password, and sets the token of the device login in a cookie.

parameters.description: UserAgent names the browser of the device
parameters.name: User-Agent

get.description: ListNeedsHuman returns the open issues of trusted authors with mobius:needs-human or mobius:question in the trees of all Workstreams, from the local copy of GitHub, by repository, Workstream and number.
ListOrganizations returns the owners of the repositories of the Mobius Apps, sorted.
ListPauses returns the pause of each Harness that has one.

post.description: Resume ends the pause of a Harness now, so the sessions that wait for it send their prompts again. A Harness with no pause is no error.

parameters.description: Harness is the name of the paused Harness
parameters.name: harness

get.description: GetRelease returns the newest release of Mobius when it is newer than this program.
ListReleaseChanges returns the first line of the message of each commit after this release up to the newest release of Mobius, the newest first.

post.description: ResumeIssue removes mobius:needs-human from an issue and from the pull request of its task, so Mobius continues the task. Mobius changes the labels with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: StartIssue adds mobius:ready to an issue, so Mobius starts the task. Mobius adds the label with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: ListMemoryVersions returns a page of the versions of the memory file of the repository, the newest first, each with the result of the check of its revert. The first version of the first page is the current text of the file. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Before is the id of a version. The page has at most 20 versions with an id below Before. With no Before, the page has the newest 20 versions
parameters.name: before

put.description: SaveMemory saves the text as the memory file of the repository and adds a version with the author owner. It does nothing when the text does not change. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius, 409 when a newer version exists than the base version, and 422 when the text has more than 200 lines.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

post.description: RevertMemory undoes the change of the version in the current text of the memory file and saves the result as a new version with the author owner. It returns 404 when the repository is not a repository of Mobius, or when the version does not exist or belongs to another repository. It returns 409 when a later version changed the part, when the revert changes nothing, or when the result has more than 200 lines.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: ID is the id of the version to revert
parameters.name: id

get.description: ListBoardTasks returns the tasks of all Workstreams that have not ended, and the tasks that ended in the last 24 hours, newest state change first, from the local copy of GitHub.
ListUnread returns each chat with unread messages.
GetUpgrade returns the error of the last upgrade.

post.description: StartUpgrade downloads the newest release, drains the agents, and restarts Mobius with the new release. It returns drained when the new release starts, and cancelled when the Owner cancels the drain. The upgrade goes on when the client closes the request.

get.description: GetUsage returns the tokens and the cost of the turns that started in the period.

parameters.description: From is the start of the period. A row is in the period when it started at From or later
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: To is the end of the period. A row is in the period when it started before To
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Tz is the IANA name of the time zone for the days. The default is UTC
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: Harness limits the rows to these Harnesses
parameters.name: harness

parameters.description: Model limits the rows to these models of the config
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: ModelVersion limits the rows to these models that the Harness reports
parameters.name: modelVersion

parameters.description: Effort limits the rows to these efforts
parameters.name: effort

parameters.description: Role limits the rows to these roles
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Repository limits the rows to these repositories as "owner/name"
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Group is the value that splits the days and the groups. With no Group, all rows are in one group
parameters.name: group

get.description: GetUsageSkills returns the skills that the sessions used or got in the period.

parameters.description: From is the start of the period. A row is in the period when its time is From or later
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: To is the end of the period. A row is in the period when its time is before To
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Harness limits the rows to these Harnesses
parameters.name: harness

parameters.description: Role limits the rows to these roles
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Repository limits the rows to these repositories as "owner/name"
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Source limits the rows to these sources. A copied skill has the source "mobius"
parameters.name: source

parameters.description: Group is the value that splits the rows. With no Group, all rows are in one group
parameters.name: group

get.description: GetUsageTimes returns the durations of the steps and the task states that started in the period.

parameters.description: From is the start of the period. A row is in the period when it started at From or later
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: To is the end of the period. A row is in the period when it started before To
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Tz is the IANA name of the time zone for the days. The default is UTC
parameters.name: tz

parameters.description: Harness limits the rows to these Harnesses
parameters.name: harness

parameters.description: Model limits the rows to these models of the config
parameters.name: model

parameters.description: ModelVersion limits the rows to these models that the Harness reports
parameters.name: modelVersion

parameters.description: Effort limits the rows to these efforts
parameters.name: effort

parameters.description: Role limits the rows to these roles
parameters.name: role

parameters.description: Repository limits the rows to these repositories as "owner/name"
parameters.name: repository

parameters.description: Group is the value that splits the days and the groups. With no Group, all rows are in one group
parameters.name: group

post.description: CreateRecording starts a voice recording on the server. The server removes the recording after 10 minutes with no chunk.

SendChunk adds samples to a recording and gives its live text. It answers 404 for an unknown recording, 409 when the sequence is not the next one, 503 while the draft converter is not ready, and 502 when it returns an error.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the recording
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Sequence is the number of the chunk. The first chunk is 0, and each chunk has the next number
parameters.name: sequence

post.description: FinishRecording converts the full audio of a recording to text and removes the recording. It answers 404 for an unknown recording. It waits up to 5 minutes for the converter. It answers 503 when the converter is still not ready after that time, and 502 when the converter returns an error.

parameters.description: ID is the id of the recording
parameters.name: id

post.description: Transcribe converts a voice recording to text. It waits up to 5 minutes for the converter. It answers 503 when the converter is still not ready after that time, and 502 when the converter returns an error.

get.description: ListWorkstreams returns the open Workstreams from the local copy of GitHub, by repository and the newest first. The copy can be one poll interval old.
ListAgents returns the sessions of a Workstream, the oldest first. Each session has the session that started it as its parent.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

put.description: SetAutopilot sets the Autopilot level of the Workstream. Mobius changes mobius:autopilot and mobius:auto-merge with the user token of the Owner, so the Owner must authorize the Mobius App first. It returns 409 with the steps when the Owner did not.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: CloseWorkstream closes the Workstream as "won't do", also when it has open issues. For each item of WorkstreamClosure, Mobius adds a comment and mobius:wont-do, and closes the item. It closes the Workstream issue last. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: WorkstreamClosure returns the items that CloseWorkstream closes, in the order of the close: the open pull requests of the tasks, the open task issues, and the Workstream issue. It reads the state from GitHub. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

post.description: CompleteWorkstream closes the Workstream issue as completed. Then Mobius ends the work of the Workstream, closes the open pull requests of its tasks, and closes the open issues below it. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream, or when the Workstream has no task or an open task.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: GetWorkstreamDetails returns the creation time and the task counts of an open Workstream. It reads the local copy. A task is an issue in the sub-issue tree of the Workstream, at each depth. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

put.description: SetEvergreen makes the Workstream evergreen or not evergreen. It returns 409 when the issue is not an open Workstream, and for the Maintenance Workstream and the Skills Workstream.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number

get.description: ListTasks returns the open and closed tasks of trusted authors in the tree of a Workstream, from the local copy of GitHub. A nested task follows its parent. The copy can be one poll interval old.

parameters.description: Owner is the owner of the repository
parameters.name: owner

parameters.description: Name is the name of the repository
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: Number is the number of the Workstream issue
parameters.name: number
